notes.title: Update! Russian localization and Special Sale
notes.notes:
A new update has been released, to further improve our beloved beggar’s journey to a world hidden on the other side of the raid

The patch will contains the Russian version of the game along with minor bug fixes. Please note that the patch is fairly big (around 40mb) because, given the way texts are interwoven in the game world, we have to repackage many textures.

To celebrate the new Russian version, we’re also offering a special sale for a very limited amount of time

notes.title: Update! New Language and Special Sale
notes.notes:
From beyond the rain, we’ve released a new update to further improve our beloved beggar’s journey!

The patch will contain the Chinese version of the game along with many bug fixes

To celebrate it’s launch, we’re also offering a special sale for a very limited amount of time

It’s time to embark on a marvellous ride….
